title: Need and Provision Path
purpose: Help children sequence the wilderness needs and God's provision.
body_markdown:
# Need and Provision Path

Use four boxes:

1. Need
2. Complaint and instruction
3. God provides
4. Gratitude and sharing

## Story prompts

- Food: Exodus 16
- Water: Exodus 17

## Teacher note

Do not promise identical miracles or shame anyone who needs practical support.
